findings.title: Cached candidate resolution is inconsistent with the seeded-project source
findings.where: Read-only canonical registries; Review orchestration and cached service; existing agent/tools/get_project.py and agent/tools/check_overlap.py
findings.problem: The cache and registry use seeded_projects.csv, but existing lookup and overlap tools read only projects.csv. The design does not require replacing those lookups, so cached candidate identities and deterministic facts cannot reliably resolve.
findings.fix: Require every project lookup, overlap check, and report resolver to use one registry-backed get_registered_project(project_id) boundary, and test canonical cached candidate resolution and provenance.

findings.title: Lazy SSE execution lacks disconnect and cancellation recovery
findings.where: Baseline and chosen architecture; SQLite changes and invariants; FastAPI and SSE contract
findings.problem: A first consumer atomically claims PENDING to RUNNING, while later consumers receive 409. No rule handles disconnected/cancelled executors, so a review can remain RUNNING forever with no terminal event or replayable result.
findings.fix: Specify a durable executor/finally failure policy or a persisted expiring lease with reclaim behavior; define reconnect behavior and test disconnect, executor exception, and exactly-one-terminal-event invariants.

findings.title: Cache identity semantics contradict the specified Pydantic normalization
findings.where: Schema changes / canonical demo fingerprint paragraph
findings.problem: The design promises rejecting any changed/omitted/null field but compares parsed ProposalCreate values. Actual ProposalCreate strips whitespace and applies defaults, so it cannot distinguish all described wire changes.
findings.fix: Choose semantic normalized equality or introduce an exact raw-payload/key-presence canonicalization contract, then add tests for whitespace and omitted/default/null behavior.

findings.title: Proposal source URL preservation is missing from the shared contract
findings.where: Schema changes; CachedScenario; frontend provenance presentation
findings.problem: ProposalCreate/Proposal has no source_url even though requirements require available proposal provenance to be preserved and displayed. Existing golden-pair proposal URLs are ignored.
findings.fix: Add source_url: str | None to ProposalCreate and carry it through cache, SQLite, API/TypeScript contracts, parsers, and provenance UI with a seeded URL rule.

findings.title: Cache proposal identity and deterministic tool input handoff is undefined
findings.where: CachedScenario; Review orchestration and cached service
findings.problem: CachedScenario stores ProposalCreate, but deterministic check_overlap requires persisted Proposal. The design neither represents proposal_id in the cache schema nor specifies constructing the stored Proposal before tools execute.
findings.fix: Add canonical proposal_id to CachedScenario, fingerprint its ProposalCreate body, construct/persist Proposal with submitted_at before review execution, and require tools to receive that persisted proposal.
